author: TeleTesselator
quote:
Over 4,000 hours of great fun in GTA V.  I would give it a 9 but RockStar saw fit to call me a cheater when I did no such thing and took 450 million out of my account. I grinded for around 2,500 hours doing heists to get that game money and they just took it on a whim.  I stopped playing for three years after that or I would likely have 6,000 total hours in the game - there is just THAT MUCH stuff to do and almost all of it is great fun!  

After they released the "Enhanced" version I reinstalled it though and have put in another ~300 hours or so. 

If you're new to the GTA series GTA-V is by far the best IMO... Much better than even GTA-VI released only a few days ago and supposedly was in development for 13 years.

author: TeleTesselator
quote:
Great graphics. Terrible story!  It plays like a soap-opera from 1990 with some added game-style gun-play. I think RockStar became confused and spent 13 years working on a photo-real version of "The Sims" or something.

62% finished and it's been like: 2 hours of "The Sims" followed by 30min. of psudo-GTA - repeated for the past umpteen hours. 

I use "The Sims" as a parallel because those such quests and activities are socialite, house-keeping, and very dull robotic meaningless dialogue sessions - quite a bit like one imagines while playing "The Sims". 

If you like TV Soap Operas with a little gun-play now and then this game is for you! Although I suspect not too many house wives or green-haired single mothers will be spending $80 or $100 on a game with GTA's past reputation.  I mean, I think the target audience for most of the past GTA games were mostly men and boys 13 to 35 with a few tom-boys sprinkled in - ALL of whom were entertained by over-the-top sx and violence mixed with wildly silly antics, no?  There's NONE of that in GTA VI.

Given the gameplay expectations one likely has from previous GTA versions this is a huge disappointment!  I have about 4,000 hours in GTA-V but not nearly that much in I, II, III, and IV just to qualify myself and my thoughts here.
